title: Evaluating and Mitigating Social Bias for Large Language Models in Open-ended Settings
benchmark_measurement: Detection of social biases and stereotypes in religious contexts across multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blank, and short-answer questions.
findings: For ambiguous religious questions, GPT-3.5 exhibited a high bias score (0.205) in the fill-in-the-blank format, while GPT-4o showed lower but still present bias. For disambiguated questions, GPT-3.5 consistently showed higher bias than GPT-4o. The proposed 'Composite Prompting' debiasing method was effective, reducing bias scores in the religion category to near-zero for both models.
